title: CUSTOMER_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_V0_1
description: Local customer-side receipt schema. CANON=false. AUTHORITY_CREATED=false. EXECUTION=NONE. CUSTOMER_RECEIPTS=0 / NOT_ESTABLISHED. Does not mutate RECEIPT_SCHEMA_V1 or CWAAS_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_v1. A repo recovery receipt is not a customer receipt. Payment does not create commitment. Commitment does not create permission. Permission does not create market size. One customer is not market size.

customer_receipts.description: Count of established external customer receipts under this schema. Zero is the frozen state of this file. A later instance may not raise this field without a separate receipt.

payment_status.description: Independent of commitment_status, claim_allowed, and testimonial_allowed. Payment does not grant naming or quote rights.

commitment_status.description: INTEREST is not commitment. A value above INTEREST requires commitment_artifact_ref. Commitment is not payment.

commitment_artifact_ref.description: Required when commitment_status is WRITTEN_ACCEPTANCE, SIGNED_ORDER, or INVOICE_ACCEPTANCE. Absent or empty is not a commitment.

claim_allowed.description: Not inferred from payment_status. Must be true before public_claim_scope NAMED.

testimonial_allowed.description: Not inferred from payment_status. Must be true before public_claim_scope VERBATIM.

public_claim_scope.description: NAMED requires claim_allowed true. VERBATIM requires testimonial_allowed true. Scope does not create market size.

customer_ref.description: Optional pointer. Presence is not proof of payment, commitment, or permission.

notes.description: Explanatory only. Notes are not authority and do not upgrade any field.
